title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: Beyer M160 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX-90)

ai_review.summary: Warm, well‑balanced audience recording captures a high‑energy Scarlet > Fire sequence and Let It Grow through Terrapin.
ai_review.review: The show bursts with energy – the band feeds off a charged crowd and delivers a scorching Scarlet > Fire and a ripping Let It Grow through Terrapin. The audience tape is surprisingly warm and clear, offering plenty of low end and good instrument separation, though some listeners wish for a matrix mix to balance levels further.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple detailed reviews praise both the performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording (well‑balanced, warm sound). Weighted average of show (≈4.5) and recording (≈4.0) yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, well‑balanced tape with clear instruments and solid low end; reviewers note it sounds great for an AUD but some suggest a matrix mix could improve level balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Cohesive and energetic set; the band rides the crowd’s excitement, delivering tight transitions especially around Scarlet > Fire.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His voice is clear and his guitar work remains strong, with only a few minor bum notes noted during Scarlet.
